scope: R34 exact private-history 500 error boundary; isolated follow-up to 49eb441; not R16 composition
behavior: Only an unexpected Exception at the exact history path is contained, including dependency failure before the endpoint.
Invoke the factory registered Exception handler; await an awaitable result or accept its synchronous Response. Preserve its 500 body, request identifier and existing class-only logging.
If the handler is absent, fails or returns an invalid/non-500 response, produce the existing generic Spanish JSON detail and available request_id; log only the original exception class.
Apply no-store and no-referrer to this contained 500. Existing CSP generation is unchanged. Exceptions on adjacent or other paths retain their existing behavior.
Controlled HTTP statuses are not converted to 500. No cursor, SQL, exception message or private plan data is echoed.

validation.note: The earlier 36-case focused run includes the same 12 boundary cases; final 12 and the 2+8 replays are repeat checks, not additional unique cases. 46 unique targeted cases across these groups.

diff_check_exception.reason: Exact prior middleware source contains historical whitespace-only lines; preserve proof bytes. New code and all other added evidence pass the diff whitespace check. Raw before body is also preserved and verified in source-snapshot-tested.zip.

before_provenance.old_history_proofs: Unmodified; base49 and earlier source ZIPs preserved.

limits: Author targeted SQLite/ASGI checks only. Prior independent 74 Python/23 VM checks remain prior checkpoints. Security replay and QA final browser remain independent review gates. No listener started, no migrations, no load measurement, no main integration.
